<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex087042026-02-2316-15-10" status="unreviewed"> 
            chos can gyi ngo bo 'gog pa'i 'gal ba'i mtshan nyid |chos can gyi khyad par la phyogs chos grub cing chos can gyi ngo bor bzung ba'i chos dang rjes su 'gro ldog <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4018">chu</rs></note> phyin ci log tu nges pa <lb n="55b7"/> ste | mig sogs bdag rtag pa gcig pu'i don byed pa de chos can | gzhan gyi don du 'gyur te | 'dus shing bsags pa'i phyir zhes pa lta bu yin zhe na |
            de chos can mig sogs pa bdag rtag pa gcig pu'i don byed pa de gzhan gyi don 'gyur du sgrub pa la 'gal ba'i rtags min par thal | mig sogs bdag rtag pa gcig pu'i don byed pa de gzhan gyi don 'gyur du sgrub <lb n="56a1"/> pa'i chos can gyi khyad par la phyogs chos su ma grub pa'i phyir te | de bsgrub kyi chos can gyi khyad par mi srid pa'i phyir | rtags ma grub na de srid par thal/de'i khyad par srid pa'i phyir ro ||</seg></TEI>
